source_fact: Registration eviction sorts eligible buffers by ascending fd, not LRU. It protects needed/current, pinned, nonweight and cloned buffers, and synchronizes before checked DSP/host unmap.
hypothesis: Larger safe window may retain more buffers and reduce map calls/flushes, but frequency/reuse policy and cyclic access must be measured. Do not model existing policy as LRU or claim a speed improvement from window size alone.
scope: Source inspection only; no new backend edit, preserved baseline unaffected.
